column1: Which player has the most kills in Cloud9's most recent match?

column1: Who had the best performance in Cloud9Õs last match?

column1: What is the average number of rounds Cloud9 plays per match?
column2: WITH recent_matches AS (SELECT maps FROM matches WHERE (team1_name = 'Cloud9' OR team2_name = 'Cloud9') ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 30), map_rounds AS (SELECT json_extract(value, '$.name') AS map_name, json_extract(value, '$.result.team1TotalRounds') + json_extract(value, '$.result.team2TotalRounds') AS total_rounds FROM recent_matches, json_each(recent_matches.maps)) SELECT AVG(total_rounds) AS avg_rounds_per_map FROM map_rounds;
